records.source: I've changed a lot over the years, but I still prefer sunny weather.
records.translation: Malaki ang ipinagbago ko sa paglipas ng mga taon, pero mas gusto ko pa rin ang maaraw na panahon.

records.source: Sometimes I daydream about our retirement... relaxing on the sunny beaches of the Fern Islands!#$e#Do you ever think about the future, @?
records.translation: Minsan ay nangangarap ako nang gising tungkol sa pagreretiro natin... nagpapahinga sa maaraw na mga dalampasigan ng Kapuluan ng Fern!#$e#Iniisip mo rin ba ang hinaharap, @?

records.source: Good morning! I got up early and baked something sweet for you! [223 234 211 651 731]#$e#I know you're strong, but you still need to eat well to stay at your best!$h
records.translation: Magandang umaga! Maaga akong bumangon at naghurno ng matamis para sa iyo! [223 234 211 651 731]#$e#Alam kong malakas ka, pero kailangan mo pa ring kumain nang maayos para manatili sa pinakamahusay mong kalagayan!$h

records.source: I can't go outside today... my hair will go limp. Forgive me, dear.$s#$e#I want to look my best for you.
records.translation: Hindi ako makakalabas ngayon... lalaylay ang buhok ko. Patawarin mo ako, mahal.$s#$e#Gusto kong palaging maganda para sa iyo.

records.source: Are you going out in this weather? Just make sure to wipe your boots on the way back in, honey.#$e#I'll just stay here and do some housework.
records.translation: Lalabas ka ba sa ganitong panahon? Tiyakin mo lang na punasan mo ang bota mo pagpasok mo ulit, mahal.#$e#Mananatili lang ako rito at gagawa ng mga gawaing-bahay.

records.source: Say 'goat cheese'!
records.translation: Sabihin mong “kesong kambing”!

records.source: Oh no... If this weather keeps up I'll get so pale.$s
records.translation: Naku... Kapag nagpatuloy ang ganitong panahon, mamumutla ako nang husto.$s

records.source: Oh, I'm glad you're back. It's so cold in here by myself... Are you almost ready to shut off the lights?
records.translation: Ah, natutuwa akong nakabalik ka. Napakalamig dito kapag mag-isa ako... Malapit ka na bang patayin ang mga ilaw?

records.source: I hope it's nice and sunny tomorrow morning. Too much rain can make me moody.$s
records.translation: Sana maganda at maaraw bukas ng umaga. Nagiging sumpungin ako kapag napakaraming ulan.$s

records.source: I hope Emily isn't too lonely all by herself. I should visit her again soon.$7
records.translation: Sana hindi masyadong nalulungkot si Emily na mag-isa. Dapat ko siyang dalawin ulit sa lalong madaling panahon.$7

records.source: Rain is horrible for a photographer. The lighting is awful, and you can't go outside without ruining your equipment!$s
records.translation: Napakasama ng ulan para sa isang potograpo. Pangit ang liwanag, at hindi ka makakalabas nang hindi sinisira ang kagamitan mo!$s

records.source: I made a hot meal for you, honey. Lots of spice, just how you like it. Enjoy! [727 231 207 199]$h
records.translation: Naghanda ako ng mainit na pagkain para sa iyo, mahal. Maraming pampalasa, gaya mismo ng gusto mo. Kain na! [727 231 207 199]$h

records.source: I never thought I'd say this, but the country lifestyle really suits me.$h
records.translation: Hindi ko inakalang sasabihin ko ito, pero talagang bagay sa akin ang pamumuhay sa bukid.$h

records.source: Hi, honey. I'm so glad you're home. I was starting to get kind of lonely.$l
records.translation: Kumusta, mahal. Natutuwa akong nakauwi ka na. Nagsisimula na akong malungkot nang kaunti.$l

records.source: Good morning! Did you sleep well?$h#$e#I think I might break out the old camera today... the lighting is just perfect.
records.translation: Magandang umaga! Nakatulog ka ba nang maayos?$h#$e#Sa tingin ko, baka gamitin ko ulit ang lumang kamera ngayon... tamang-tama ang liwanag.

records.source: Good morning, dear! Smells good, doesn't it? I made you breakfast! [194 195 210 211 216]#$e#I know you're busy with your work. I'm here to support you in any way I can!
records.translation: Magandang umaga, mahal! Mabango, hindi ba? Ipinaghanda kita ng almusal! [194 195 210 211 216]#$e#Alam kong abala ka sa trabaho. Narito ako para suportahan ka sa anumang paraan na kaya ko!

records.source: Did you sleep okay? You were snoring a little.$h#$e#I've got some chores to do in here. Have a good day.
records.translation: Nakatulog ka ba nang maayos? Medyo humihilik ka kagabi.$h#$e#May ilang gawain akong kailangang tapusin dito. Magandang araw sa iyo.

records.source: I'm glad I've learned to enjoy cleaning! The house gets dirty very easily.$10#$e#It's satisfying to get everything squeaky clean.#$e#Can I have a kiss before you leave?$11
records.translation: Natutuwa akong natutuhan kong magustuhan ang paglilinis! Napakadaling dumumi ng bahay.$10#$e#Napakasarap sa pakiramdam kapag napakalinis ng lahat.#$e#Puwede ba akong humingi ng halik bago ka umalis?$11

records.source: Good morning, dear. Another day of farm chores, huh?#$e#I'll be thinking of you. <$h
records.translation: Magandang umaga, mahal. Isa na namang araw ng mga gawain sa bukid, ano?#$e#Iisipin kita. <$h

records.source: I felt like I had no direction in life before I met you. Now I have exactly what I want.$l
records.translation: Pakiramdam ko ay wala akong direksiyon sa buhay bago kita nakilala. Ngayon, nasa akin na ang mismong gusto ko.$l

records.source: You look like you've been working hard, dear. Let me help you de-stress.$l
records.translation: Mukhang nagsikap ka nang husto, mahal. Tulungan kitang maibsan ang pagod mo.$l

records.source: I always feel best when I'm outside, breathing fresh air.#$b#Don't get me wrong, your grandpa's old cottage is very nice! But nothing beats this beautiful landscape.
records.translation: Laging pinakamaganda ang pakiramdam ko kapag nasa labas ako at nilalanghap ang sariwang hangin.#$b#Huwag kang magkamali ng intindi, napakaganda ng lumang Kubo ng Lolo mo! Pero walang tatalo sa magandang tanawing ito.

records.source: We've got to make sure the farm is cute! That might be important... right, honey?
records.translation: Kailangan nating tiyaking kaaya-aya ang bukid! Baka mahalaga iyon... tama, mahal?

records.source: Hi, honey! If I knew more about farm work I'd help you out more. Sorry!#$e#I'll be thinking of you.$h
records.translation: Kumusta, mahal! Kung mas marami akong alam tungkol sa trabaho sa bukid, mas matutulungan sana kita. Pasensiya na!#$e#Iisipin kita.$h

records.source: I'm just going to do some dusting over here. That should help you out, right?#$e#*phew*... it's hot out here.
records.translation: Magpupunas lang ako ng alikabok dito. Makakatulong iyon sa iyo, hindi ba?#$e#*hingal*... ang init dito sa labas.

records.source: Don't overwork yourself, dear.#$e#Make sure and take a break every now and then, or get something to eat.$h
records.translation: Huwag mong pagurin nang sobra ang sarili mo, mahal.#$e#Tiyaking magpahinga paminsan-minsan, o kumain ka.$h

records.source: Looks like a good day to work on my tan, don't you think, sweetheart?
records.translation: Mukhang magandang araw para magpaaraw, hindi ba, mahal?

records.source: I'm going to socialize in town for a bit today.
records.translation: Makikisalamuha muna ako sa mga tao sa bayan ngayon.

records.source: It was nice seeing everyone in town. Did you have a good day, dear?
records.translation: Masayang makita ang lahat sa bayan. Naging maganda ba ang araw mo, mahal?

records.source: Isn't it strange? I'm not used to being a mother.
records.translation: Hindi ba kakaiba? Hindi pa ako sanay maging ina.

records.source: Isn't %kid2 a very good-looking baby?
records.translation: Hindi ba napakagandang sanggol si %kid2?

records.source: A big house, two kids, and a beautiful plot of land. I'm not sure what else I could ask for.
records.translation: Malaking bahay, dalawang anak, at magandang lupain. Hindi ko alam kung ano pa ang mahihiling ko.

records.source: So, what are we planting this season?
records.translation: Aba, ano ang itatanim natin ngayong panahon?

records.source: Now that winter's over, we've got lots of sunny weather to look forward to. I'm excited.
records.translation: Ngayong tapos na ang taglamig, marami tayong maaraw na araw na maaasahan. Nasasabik ako.

records.source: Sorry if I don't look my best... the air is just so humid that my hair doesn't hold up too well.
records.translation: Pasensiya na kung hindi ako mukhang nasa pinakamaganda kong ayos... napakamaalinsangan ng hangin kaya hindi nananatiling maayos ang buhok ko.

records.source: It's summer... that means the house is full of flies and ants... yuck.$s
records.translation: Tag-init na... ibig sabihin, punô ng langaw at langgam ang bahay... kadiri.$s

records.source: I already miss summer...
records.translation: Nami-miss ko na agad ang tag-init...

records.source: Fall is kind of sad for me... everything is dying.$5
records.translation: Medyo malungkot para sa akin ang taglagas... namamatay ang lahat.$5

records.source: My skin feels so dry in this weather.
records.translation: Napakatuyo ng balat ko sa ganitong panahon.

records.source: For some reason, the snowy weather gives me cravings for pink cake...
records.translation: Hindi ko alam kung bakit, pero natatakam ako sa rosas na keyk kapag maniyebe ang panahon...

records.source: Aren't you glad winter's over, honey? Things seem more hopeful now.
records.translation: Hindi ka ba natutuwang tapos na ang taglamig, mahal? Parang mas may pag-asa na ngayon.

records.source: I love watching the fireflies on a hot summer's night. It's the closest I'll ever come to visiting the stars.
records.translation: Gustong-gusto kong pagmasdan ang mga alitaptap sa mainit na gabi ng tag-init. Iyon na ang pinakamalapit kong mararating sa mga bituin.

records.source: Even though I prefer summer, fall might be the best season to take pictures. Those long, low shadows...
records.translation: Kahit mas gusto ko ang tag-init, baka taglagas ang pinakamagandang panahon para kumuha ng mga larawan. Ang mahahaba at mabababang aninong iyon...

records.source: I was just thinking about the time you helped me open a jar of pickles. Remember that?$h#$e#We've come a long way since then.$l
records.translation: Naaalala ko lang ang pagkakataong tinulungan mo akong magbukas ng garapon ng atsara. Naaalala mo iyon?$h#$e#Napakalayo na ng narating natin mula noon.$l
